headline: Chris bags it, Sara and Sofia slip on the banana skin
text: A tidy one for Chris, with Colombia (Chris) nicking a 1-0 win over Ghana (Sara). Meanwhile, Argentina (Nana) and Cape Verde (Vicki) shared the points, as did Australia (Nana) and Egypt (Sofia) — proper draw-lovers, that lot. At the top, Max is still the king of the heap on 26 points. At the other end, Sofia remains bottom on 10, with Christopher just above her on 11. Not a disaster for Nana, but two draws in a row rather takes the shine off.
